critique: The black background and magenta line color match the intended preset family, but the result is substantially less fractal than the reference intent. The frame is dominated by a sparse set of extremely long, smooth, nearly parallel diagonal streaks, including several clipped and overbright foreground bands at the far left. Most of the image is empty black, with almost no branching, granular breakup, or layered fine-line detail. The field reads as a simple diagonal line array rather than an intricate turbulent fractal-line texture.

suggestions.why: Increase the base-shape row count so the image is populated by a much denser field of strings instead of a few isolated, widely spaced bars.
Increase the fractal field's size influence so the strings receive visibly stronger nonuniform size modulation and break up the currently smooth, uniform streaks.
Raise String Size Random to introduce stronger strand-to-strand variation, reducing the repeated uniform bright foreground lines.
